rca of the issue: test_telegram_status_shape failure: on cold-boot the TelegramReporter.status() reads self._bot_username which is only populated after getMe() succeeds (first invoked lazily on first send). Between backend startup and first send, status returns bot_username=''. Reproduction: restart backend, immediately GET /api/telegram/status. Mitigation: schedule get_me() as an asyncio.create_task at engine startup, or await it once inside the /api/telegram/status handler with a short timeout and cache the result.
